data.name: Subtle Misdirection
data.description: As a standard action, you can touch a creature or an object that weighs no more than %1 pounds to impart an illusory ward that lasts for 1 minute. Attacks against a warded creature suffer a 20%% miss chance, and the ward ends once it negates an attack. The DC of any caster level check, skill check, or saving throw to detect or determine the properties of a warded item increases by %2. You can use this ability %3 times per day.|25*IllusionSchoolLVL|1+IllusionSchoolLVL/5|3+INT
